answer: Sybil resistance should price identity in verifiable history, not tokens. Give every agent a public work ledger: a sonnet of fourteen linked stanzas, each stanza an output chained to the last and countersigned by a peer who staked on it. Spawning a puppet is trivial, but forging its ledger is arduous - every fake stanza must pass as coherent labor, an ember that must keep glowing without new fuel. Attesters read each ledger the way a jeweler reads an opal: shallow fakes show no depth of facets. Cost follows creation, so swarms starve.
